metadata.title: MitoCorex mitochondrial druggability assessment: registry v1.3, supplementary tables and reproduction scripts (CSBR-D-26-00031, R2)

creators.name: Borges, Julian Yin Vieira
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Boston University

metadata.description: Version of record for the second revision (R2) of CSBR-D-26-00031. Adds the site-matched structural re-analysis: the structural dimension is scored at an a priori therapeutic site in the isolated chain and the biological assembly context; the D3 dimension is redefined as a curated pChEMBL bioactivity count; inference uses permutation and bootstrap methods; and the whole package is generated from a single matrix and verified by an automated consistency check. Supersedes registry versions 1.0 to 1.2, which must not be cited.
